thread:
Alice M: Planning to push console v2.3.1 to prod at 16:30 PT. small asset changes + client-side cache-bust. Can someone own smoke and CDN invalidation? I'll do rollout and watch metrics.

Brennan: I can take smoke tests. What's the rollback window?

Alice M: 30m post-deploy for quick rollback. If errors spike >3% or 5xx >0.5% we roll back. @Carla can you run invalidation + edge warmup ~5m before deploy?

Carla: Yep, I got this. I'll queue the invalidation and then fire our prefetch to top POPs. Ping me when canary is green. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: CI: build 0x9f4 passed; canary deploy queued.

Dave: FYI, new nav is behind feature flags — keeping them off until we validate the release.

Lucy: I'll monitor error rates + do the UX smoke checklist: login, settings save, dataset load, search. Will post results here.

Carla: Invalidation command I'm going to run (edge):

```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E12ABC34D5FG --paths "/static/console/*v2.3.1*"
```

Then warmup: the script sends GETs for critical assets to the top 10 POPs.

Brennan: For smoke I have a quick script that runs after canary: curl checks + screenshots. Example: 

```
./scripts/smoke-checks.sh --target https://console.redwood.ai --checks login,search,settings --screenshot
```

Alice M: Timeline: 16:25 - invalidation + warmup; 16:30 - deploy start; 16:34 - canary pass window; 16:40 - full roll. If canary fails -> rollback and re-invalidate previous stable assets. @deploy-bot kick when ready.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 16:30:10 — health OK. 200/200 checks passed.

Brennan: Smoke results: login OK, settings OK, search functional but ~120ms slower than baseline (within SLO). No errors observed.

Lucy: UX spot-check done, screenshots and notes uploaded to https://internal.redwood/release-artifacts/1923456789. No visual regressions on main flows.

Carla: Invalidation finished at 16:26. Warmup requests sent to top POPs, caches primed.

Alice M: Great. Rolling to full now. Reminder: if anyone sees >0.5% 5xx call rollback and notify infra. Thanks team :tada:
